evidence.reason: The git runner is scoped with `-C repoRoot`, but inherited `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE`/`GIT_COMMON_DIR` can override repository selection, so reads and writes may target another repository. The adjacent gh runner already strips its analogous repository-selection variable via `unsetEnv`; the git runner omits the equivalent. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the intended repo-scoping behavior, not a new contract requirement.
